Definition: from G5172; to indulge in luxury:--live in pleasure.
BiblicalUsage: trypháō is the word for to indulge in luxury. It appears once, in James 5:5.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God gave us trypháō because the idea it carries belongs in His Word.
